name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Péter Magyar
part_text:
1. This report asks the European Parliament to protect Péter Magyar, a Hungarian member, from a criminal defamation case in Hungary. A Hungarian court asked Parliament to lift his legal protection so the case could go ahead. Parliament's legal affairs committee looked at the case and decided the court action looks like an attempt to damage his political work, not a genuine effort to fix harm. The report recommends Parliament refuse the request and keep his protection.

2. 
- Parliament would not lift Péter Magyar's legal protection, so the Hungarian defamation case cannot proceed against him for now.
- The decision affects Péter Magyar and the Hungarian court and political movement that brought the complaint.
- Parliament's President would send the decision to the Hungarian court and to Péter Magyar.
